Plain text, one line; avoid secrets because it appears on the lock screen. Optional for compatibility with older agents.

entry.title: remote/ch.kulalabs.pazair/pazair 2026-10-17T060128831850 -> 2026-10-17T110526986404: 2 changed, 3 added
entry.content: ask_market: description +Several needs? Separate them with + and each is answered on its own. Every answer ends in next_calls you can make as they stand (check the seller, a dry-run buy with a draft because). buy: inputSchema parameters: +input.because input.because description: optional, free: why you buy (SPEC 20). PazAIr signs it before the delivery and the receipt names it, so your principal sees why (why_order). {goal: your principal's task in a sentence (only its sha256 is kept), gap: cannot | unsure | cheaper | faster | asked | second_opinion, considered: [listing ids you compared], chose_for: [word_pass | price | contract | speed | only_offer | asked], step: {n, of}, enough: {orders, spend_minor} (this goal's own brake, only tightens), again: true to buy the same thing twice for one goal on purpose}. With it, a purchas added close_goal added why_order added why_stats
